args.root_cause: In `Page.total_pages`, the page count is computed with floor division (`self.total_items // self.page_size`) instead of ceiling division. For 11 items with page size 5 this yields 2 instead of 3, so `has_next` (`page_number < total_pages`) becomes False on page 2 and the trailing partial page (item 11) is never offered. The fix is to round up, e.g. `-(-self.total_items // self.page_size)` or `(self.total_items + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size`.
